description.value: C-Lovers is a BC-born fish and chips chain founded in 1984, serving hand-battered halibut, haddock, cod, salmon, and prawns alongside hand-cut Kennebec potato chips in a casual, family-friendly dine-in setting. The Abbotsford location is an Ocean Wise partner, meaning its seafood is certified as responsibly and sustainably sourced. Both dine-in and takeout are available, making it a practical stop for a hungry cyclist wanting a filling seafood meal.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (10 spaces) at 85m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms C-Lovers Abbotsford is an active fish-and-chips restaurant at 7 - 32451 South Fraserway, with phone 604-859-9747 matching OSM. The site details both dine-in and takeout menus, Ocean Wise sustainable seafood sourcing, and a 'Gluten Friendly!' label on the chowder in the takeout menu. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM 'community' field is set to 'Chilliwack' but the business is clearly located in Abbotsford per website and address — likely an OSM data error.
Minor street name spelling discrepancy: OSM uses 'South Fraser Way', website uses 'South Fraserway'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, active dine-in and takeout restaurant on a main road in Abbotsford; a practical and filling meal stop for touring cyclists in the Fraser Valley.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Take-out menu labels the C-Food Chowder as 'Gluten Friendly!' No vegetarian or vegan options explicitly identified
